$description: Semantic tokens: what a value is for, not where it sits on a scale. Components read only these and their own component tokens. Colours are themed: light and dark are built as mirror images, a pure canvas, an elevated surface one step off it, and a hairline that only just separates them. Every token compiles to --aihio-<group>-<name>; colour names follow the schema's intent vocabulary where they meet it (primary-action, secondary-action, destructive, overlay, surface).

overlay-scrim.$description: Modal backdrop scrim behind blocking overlays.

surface.$description: Corner radius for cards, alerts, and other framed surfaces.

interactive.$description: Default corner radius for buttons, inputs, toggles, and menus.

interactive-compact.$description: Tighter radius for dense interactive children such as tabs and menu items.

pill.$description: Fully rounded presentation for badges, avatars, and pill-shaped affordances.

cluster-gap-tight.$description: Tight spacing inside grouped interactive controls and menu chrome.

stack-tight.$description: Compact vertical rhythm for headings with short supporting copy.

control-gap.$description: Default inline gap between icons, labels, and grouped actions.

stack-sm.$description: Short vertical separation between related blocks such as alert content and panels.

stack-md.$description: Standard section spacing within surfaced components.

stack-lg.$description: Large separation for footer action areas and major section breaks.

field-padding-inline-sm.$description: Inline padding for compact form fields.

field-padding-inline.$description: Inline padding for default form fields.

field-padding-inline-lg.$description: Inline padding for spacious form fields.

field-padding-block-sm.$description: Block padding for compact form fields.

field-padding-block.$description: Block padding for default form fields.

field-padding-block-lg.$description: Block padding for spacious form fields.

form-field-gap.$description: Recommended gap between labels, help text, and form controls.

body.$description: Interface and body typeface for every component and page surface.

code.$description: Typeface for code samples, markup, token names, and other fixed-width data.

body.$description: Default body and control tracking. Slightly negative, because the system stack sets a touch wide at UI sizes.

heading.$description: Tracking for surface titles and section headings.

display.$description: Tracking for large display type, where glyph gaps open up as size grows.

label.$description: Positive tracking for the one place it earns its keep: small capitalised labels.

body-sm.$description: Supporting text size for descriptions and secondary copy.

control-sm.$description: Compact text size for small controls.

control-lg.$description: Larger text size for prominent controls.

badge.$description: Dense label size for badges and tiny metadata chips.

heading.$description: Large surface title size. Sized to lead a card, not to headline a page — a title much larger than this stops reading as part of the surface it sits on.

heading-sm.$description: Compact surface title size for dialogs and smaller panels.

control.$description: Emphasized but compact weight for controls and inline titles.

body.$description: Default readable line height for body and field text.

compact.$description: Tight line height for headings, labels, and short control text.

overlay.$description: Elevation for popovers and transient overlays.

modal.$description: Deeper elevation for blocking modal dialogs.

feedback-fast.$description: Fast hover and menu-item feedback transitions.

overlay.$description: Entrance timing for larger blocking overlays.

spinner.$description: One full rotation of an indeterminate busy indicator.

page-bg.$description: Default page canvas and neutral active backgrounds.

page-fg.$description: Primary foreground on the page canvas.

surface-bg.$description: Raised surface background for cards, alerts, and dialog panels.

overlay-bg.$description: Surface background for transient overlays such as dropdowns.

overlay-highlight-bg.$description: The highlighted item inside an overlay: the active combobox option or a hovered dropdown item. It has to differ from overlay-bg, which control-highlight-bg does not in the dark theme.

muted-bg.$description: Muted fill for grouped controls and subdued surfaces.

control-highlight-bg.$description: Hover and pressed highlight background for neutral controls.

control-highlight-fg.$description: Foreground on hover and pressed highlight backgrounds.

destructive-bg.$description: Destructive emphasis background and error color.

destructive-text.$description: Destructive text and iconography drawn directly on page or surface backgrounds, where the emphasis background is not used.

success-bg.$description: Emphasis background for confirmed and healthy states.

success-text.$description: Success text and iconography drawn directly on page or surface backgrounds.

warning-bg.$description: Emphasis background for states that need attention but are not failures.

warning-fg.$description: Foreground on warning emphasis backgrounds. Dark, because an accessible amber fill is light in both themes.

warning-text.$description: Warning text and iconography drawn directly on page or surface backgrounds.

border-subtle.$description: Default border color for surfaces and outlines.

field-border.$description: Default border color for editable form fields.

focus-ring.$description: Focus indication ring for keyboard interactions.
